# Cases whose expected value no source independent of the emulator settles yet, kept outside
# scalars/ so that no test runs them. Each query stands alone, without the scalars fixture, and is
# followed by an empty "?>" line. A maintainer fills those in with BigQuery's answers through
# `just bigquery-answers PROJECT`; each answered case then moves to scalars/, written with "=>",
# or with "!>" to known_bugs.txt where the emulator answers otherwise.

# SAFE.SESSION_USER() is rejected by BigQuery, but TYPEOF can erase its argument before
# execution. Check whether BigQuery still rejects the prefix in this context.
SELECT TYPEOF(SAFE.SESSION_USER())
?>
